thread: Two of the first words you learn in Chinese, 不 and 一, are also two of the most mispronounced. Their tone changes depending on the next syllable. Here are the rules HSK listening expects you to know 🧵

2/ 不 (bù) becomes bú before a 4th tone:
不是 búshì
不对 búduì
不去 búqù
Before tones 1, 2 and 3 it stays bù: 不吃 bù chī, 不来 bù lái, 不好 bù hǎo.

3/ 一 (yī) becomes yí before a 4th tone:
一个 yí ge
一样 yíyàng
Before tones 1, 2 and 3 it becomes yì:
一天 yì tiān
一年 yì nián
一起 yìqǐ

4/ But 一 keeps yī when you count, read digits or use it as an ordinal:
一、二、三 yī, èr, sān
第一 dì yī
十一 shíyī
Your turn: how do you pronounce 不要? Practice HSK 1–3 (HSK 1 is free): https://hsk-path-eosin.vercel.app #learnchinese #HSK
bonus:
Quick tone quiz 🎧 In 一点儿 ("a little"), how is 一 pronounced?

A) yī
B) yí
C) yì

Reply with your answer, no peeking at a dictionary. #learnchinese
